component.name: Khad Media Player
component.summary: GTK media and IPTV player powered by mpv

description.p: Khad Media Player is a GTK 3 frontend for media URL playback, YouTube search via yt-dlp, queue management, IPTV M3U browsing and history.
This Flatpak build uses the host system mpv binary (external window mode). Embedded libmpv rendering is not supported in this package yet.
Alpha preview with .deb builder and experimental Flatpak. See docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md.
